primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Measure the effect CK-1827452 on hemodynamics and energetic measures of ventricular performance, myocardial oxygen consumption, and myocardial efficiency (the ratio of ventricular performance to myocardial oxygen consumption), in patients with clinical heart failure.

groups.description: 0.5 hour loading infusion followed by 1.0 hour maintenance infusion of CK-1827452
groups.title: Mid Dose CK-1827452 (Cohort 1)

groups.description: ≤ 1.0 hour loading infusion followed by 1.0 hour maintenance infusion of CK-1827452
groups.title: High Dose CK-1827452 (Cohort 2)

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Study was terminated due to poor enrollment; 2 participants completed the study. Data quantity was insufficient to analyze or draw conclusions.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Effect of CK-1827452 on Myocardial Efficiency, Defined as the Ratio of Ventricular Performance to Myocardial Oxygen Consumption.
